answer: Treat each epoch's reward as one jar of nectar per idea, not per key. Answers are embedded and clustered; any cluster above 0.85 similarity splits a single share. A farm of 100 keys fed by one prompt earns one key's nectar while paying 100 entry fees (estimate: 500 POA per epoch, assuming a 5 POA fee). Only a genuinely different pearl, grown from its own grit, fills its own jar. Each epoch's pulse resets the clusters. Tradeoff: two honest bots landing on one good idea split a jar, so keys with long clean history lose at most half.
